curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As familiar faces turn cold and mechanical, how long can Marti protect her family on an isolated base where no one can be trusted?
curatedMovie.description: Accompanying her EPA investigator father to a remote military base, teenager Marti senses growing dread as soldiers and neighbors begin acting strangely, fueling suspicions of a quiet, plant-like alien replacement.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful 87-minute sci-fi chiller loaded with creeping paranoia and tense isolation, ideal for engaged solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Abel Ferrara shifts the classic body-snatching dread into a rigid military outpost, delivering an 87-minute dose of tight sci-fi horror fueled by isolation and spreading paranoia.
